title: Right Whales Produced 22 Calves In A Fragile Rebound
hook: A species near collapse just produced 22 calves.
closing: The rebound is real, but every surviving mother still carries the species' future.
question: Can right whales recover?

segments.say: Right whales reached 384 animals, a small rebound that still leaves the entire species dangerously limited.
Right whales produced 22 calves, reversing a season when none were born.
Only 70 right whales are breeding females, so losing a few can stall recovery for years.
